info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Counterparty Risk Management API
info.description: The Counterparty Risk Management API enables financial institutions to update and manage risk assessments for counterparties dynamically. This API provides essential operations that allow users to patch existing risk information based on changing circumstances or new data inputs. It is particularly useful for risk management teams and compliance officers needing to ensure accurate and up-to-date counterparty evaluations. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their risk mitigation strategies and maintain regulatory compliance.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specified counterparty risk. Make sure to provide all required fields in the request body to ensure a successful update.

requestBody.description: Update the counterparty risk details for the specified party. This request body should contain the necessary fields that need to be modified in the counterparty's risk profile.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the updated resource is returned.
